description.value: The Black Goose Inn is a British, Irish, and Scottish pub housed in a heritage building from 1921 within Beach Acres Resort on the outskirts of Parksville, featuring ocean views and wood-burning fireplaces in every room. A large sunny patio welcomes dogs, and the kitchen turns out hearty pub classics alongside a seasonal afternoon high tea service and regular live music nights. It is a well-established local landmark in a beach resort setting, drawing both regulars and visitors.
